quizzes.title: Evian Summit 2026 Practice
quizzes.passage: The Group of Seven, or G7, is described as an informal forum comprising some of the world's most advanced industrialised economies. It serves as a platform for consultations on major economic, political and strategic issues. Leadership of the forum rotates among its member states. The booklet says that discussions at the summit directly affect the development of financial regulations and economic frameworks used worldwide. Leaders also use the platform to coordinate on energy insecurity and geopolitical instability, and collective decisions of the G7 are said to influence global trade policies, investment flows and economic recovery strategies. The forum is also presented as a primary symbol of cooperation among the world's major economies. Its commitments are described as a catalyst for climate action and humanitarian assistance, and dialogue is said to help find common ground on complex global challenges. Current affairs material on the summit describes the event as one of a numbered series of meetings. The material also notes that the grouping's pillars of influence include its effect on regulation, its response to crises and its role in building consensus. The booklet is a current affairs tutorial, and it ends with practice questions on the summit, its history and its members. Those questions cover the forum's establishment, its member countries and the rotation of its presidency.

questions.q: In which city was the 2026 G7 Summit held?
questions.explanation: The booklet places the 52nd G7 Summit in Evian-les-Bains.

questions.q: Which phrase is the theme of the 2026 G7 Summit?
options: Forging New Partnerships and Rebuilding International Solidarity
Resilient Democracies for a Peaceful World
questions.explanation: The booklet gives the 2026 theme as 'Forging New Partnerships and Rebuilding International Solidarity'.

questions.q: At the 2026 summit, PM Modi took part in which session?
questions.explanation: The booklet says PM Modi participated in the 52nd G7 Summit Outreach Session.

questions.q:
Read the assertion and reason and choose the correct option.
Assertion (A): India's participation in the 2026 summit marked its first-ever participation in the G7 Outreach Process.
Reason (R): The invitation was recorded as marking India's consecutive participation in the G7 Outreach Process.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation: The booklet describes the invitation as a consecutive participation, so A is false while R is true.

questions.q:
Match List I with List II:
I. Edition of the 2026 summit
II. Host city of the 2026 summit
III. Indian leader who attended the 2026 summit
IV. India's consecutive participation count
A. PM Modi
B. Eighth
C. Evian-les-Bains
D. 52nd
questions.explanation: The 2026 edition is 52nd, the host is Evian-les-Bains, the leader is PM Modi and the count is eighth.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the 2026 summit:
I. The summit was held in Paris, France.
II. The summit's theme included the word 'Solidarity'.
III. India's participation in the Outreach Process was its sixth consecutive one.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Only statement II matches the booklet, since the summit was in Evian-les-Bains and the count was eighth.

questions.q:
Consider the statements below on the 2026 summit. How many of them are correct?
The summit was held in Evian-les-Bains, France.
PM Modi took part in the Outreach Session.
The summit was the 50th edition of the G7 Summit.
questions.explanation: The first two statements match the booklet, while the 50th edition is wrong because the summit is the 52nd.

quizzes.title: Pillars of G7 Influence Practice
quizzes.passage: The booklet on the G7 presents the forum's influence under several pillars, and gives each one a heading. Among the headings are Regulatory Influence, Collective Response to Crises, Driving Global Frameworks and Consensus-Building. The G7 is described as an informal forum comprising some of the world's most advanced industrialised economies, and it serves as a platform for consultations on major economic, political and strategic issues. The 2026 summit was held in Evian-les-Bains, and its theme was 'Forging New Partnerships and Rebuilding International Solidarity.' The booklet says that PM Modi attended the Outreach Session, and that the invitation marked India's eighth consecutive participation in the G7 Outreach Process. The booklet's title for this section is 'The Pillars of G7 Influence: Shaping the World Stage.' Each pillar is presented with its own heading and description. The booklet is a current affairs tutorial, and it ends with practice questions on the summit, its history and its members. Those questions cover the forum's establishment, its member countries and the rotation of its presidency. The material belongs to a June 2026 current affairs booklet that covers summits, reports and indices. The booklet's headings name the pillars that are used to explain the forum's influence. Pillar descriptions appear in a diagram-style layout, with each heading placed beside its text.

questions.q: On which two issues do G7 leaders use the platform to coordinate?
questions.explanation: The booklet says leaders coordinate on energy insecurity and geopolitical instability.

questions.q: Collective decisions of the G7 are said to influence which of the following?
options: Membership rules of the United Nations
Domestic tax rates of non-member countries
Global trade policies, investment flows and economic recovery strategies
questions.explanation: The booklet links collective G7 decisions to trade policies, investment flows and recovery strategies.

questions.q: What do dialogue and coordination help the G7 find on complex global challenges?
questions.explanation: The booklet says the G7 reinforces dialogue and coordination to find common ground on complex global challenges.

questions.q:
Read the assertion and reason and choose the correct option.
Assertion (A): The forum is described as a primary symbol of cooperation among the world's smaller economies.
Reason (R): The forum fosters trust and partnership among the world's major economies.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation: The booklet calls the forum a symbol of cooperation among major economies, so A is false while R is true.

questions.q:
Match List I with List II:
I. Regulatory Influence
II. Collective Response to Crises
III. Driving Global Frameworks
IV. Future-Proofing Governance
A. Enables a unified front in economic crises, armed conflicts and public health emergencies
B. Summit discussions shape financial regulations used worldwide
C. Leaders influence the evolution of governance to meet modern challenges
D. Commitments serve as a catalyst for climate action and humanitarian assistance
questions.explanation: Regulatory Influence matches financial regulations, Collective Response to Crises matches the unified front, Driving Global Frameworks matches climate commitments and Future-Proofing Governance matches governance.

questions.q:
Consider the statements below about the forum's influence:
I. Summit discussions directly affect financial regulations used worldwide.
II. The forum is described as a formal international organisation with a permanent secretariat.
III. Commitments made during the summit serve as a catalyst for climate action and humanitarian assistance.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Statement II is wrong because the booklet calls the G7 an informal forum, while I and III are stated.

questions.q:
Consider the statements below on the forum's influence. How many of them are correct?
The forum enables a unified front when addressing public health emergencies.
Leaders use the platform to coordinate on energy insecurity.
The forum is described as a symbol of rivalry between major economies.
questions.explanation: The first two statements match the booklet, while the third reverses the booklet's description of cooperation.
